title: Add-Expense-VAT-settings-to-Contoso-demo-tool
summary: The Contoso demo tool for expense management was updated to include VAT rate settings and reorganize GL account setup, improving the initialization of expense demo data.
key_points: VAT rate creation logic was refactored to be more maintainable
GL account setup was added to the demo data initialization sequence
Expense categories and subcategories data structures were updated
Demo data setup follows a clearer two-phase structure (Setup Data then Master Data)
Test utilities for Shopify were adjusted to work with updated demo data initialization
